aboutme_introduction: You have found the portfolio of Tycho Kerkhofs. Currently, I am a second-year game design student at CMGT at Saxion in Enschede (the Netherlands). I am very passionate about Virtual Reality and its games. Eventually I would like to create Virtual Reality games and applications. In my free time I do a lot with photography. Most of the time I will post my photos to my Instagram profile.
aboutme_studyinfo: Before this study I already finished the MBO study Applicatie- & Mediaontwikkelaar at Summa College in Eindhoven (the Netherlands). Here I mainly worked with the languages C#, SQL, HTML, CSS and PHP. In the 3 years of this study, I also had 2 internships where I learned a lot about the professional IT industry.
aboutme_websiteinfo: On my website you can find information about my projects, my resume, a way to contact me, and a way to go to my other socials.
intern_countit_description: My second internship I did was at Count-IT in Herkenbosch (the Netherlands). This company focusses on creating cash register systems. My task was to make a quick and easy to use debug functionality to the app, so that bugs were a lot easier to fix. I had to work in C# to make everything. I also had to connect the application to actual cash registers and ATM's. I learned a lot about C# and the professional IT industry in this internship.
intern_bonsai_description: My first internship I ever did was at Bonsai Media in Nederweert (the Nederlands). I mainly worked with WordPress, and I often needed to change the styling in CSS.
